pipeline: doppler-locate (MIT) documented flow: dopploc search, dopploc score; events as measured in its cases/oyster.toml
regional_box_note: 300 x 300 km regional box centred on New York City (40.71, -74.01); not the continental US and not blind: the box was chosen knowing the answer is on Long Island.
camera_coordinates: camera coordinates not published; only the town (hamlet Oyster Bay, NY) is known, so there is no error in metres, only the town match
settings: [search] bbox -75.789,39.361,-72.231,42.059, gpu=false, workers=3, offset_tol_s=8; [score] dt_sweep -8..8 step 0.1; atmosphere gfs (default); numba CPU backend; BelowNormal priority; another solver was running at the same time
osm_attribution: Hamlet and town polygons (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via Nominatim.
n_flight_pairs_note: 48 flight pairs survive in this 300 x 300 km box (the README's 1,060 is for the whole continental US)
readme_reference: doppler-locate README (cases/oyster.toml, CONUS search): rank 1, score 3.662 vs 3.504. This regional run: rank 1, score 3.662 vs 3.483.
event_measurements: not repeated here: the two events are the ones measured in doppler-locate's cases/oyster.toml (E1 f0 112.735 Hz, E2 f0 134.415 Hz; audio CPA 2155.80 s and 3072.36 s)
